clues: Linus carried either a headlamp or a bike light.
Of Jonah and whoever arrived at 7:40 p.m., one carried the headlamp and the other the penlight.
One of Mabel and the person who reached the Point arrived at 8:00 p.m., and the other at 7:20 p.m.
Zeke and the person on the beach are two different people: one arrived at 8:20 p.m., the other at 7:20 p.m.
Whoever went to the slipway got there at either 7:00 p.m. or 7:40 p.m.
Whoever wore the headlamp arrived exactly 20 minutes after whoever carried the penlight.
The person at the Point arrived exactly an hour after the person at the pier.
The person with the lantern arrived at either 7:00 p.m. or 7:20 p.m.
hints: Look at the Point in clues 3 and 7. How late must it be, and which of clue 3's two times fits?
Use two clues together: clues 7 and 3 fix the Point's time, and then Mabel's. Later, test Jonah's light; clue 2 leaves him only two.
Suppose Jonah had the penlight. Then clue 2 gives the 7:40 p.m. person the headlamp, and clue 6 puts the penlight at 7:20 p.m.: Mabel's time, not his.
With the headlamp Jonah's, clue 2 gives the penlight to 7:40 p.m., and clue 6 puts the headlamp 20 minutes later. Which spot goes with that time?

solution.key_idea: Supposing Jonah had the penlight puts the headlamp at 7:40 p.m. and the penlight at Mabel's 7:20 p.m.; so Jonah had the headlamp.
steps: Clue 7 puts the Point at 8:00 p.m. or later, so clue 3 puts it at 8:00 p.m. and Mabel at 7:20 p.m.
Clue 7 then puts the pier at 7:00 p.m., and clue 5 puts the slipway at 7:40 p.m.
By clue 4, Zeke came at 8:20 p.m., and Mabel, at 7:20 p.m., was on the beach. So Zeke was on the seawall.
Clue 2 gives Jonah the headlamp or the penlight, and the 7:40 p.m. person the other.
Suppose Jonah had the penlight. Then the headlamp came at 7:40 p.m., so the penlight came at 7:20 p.m. (clue 6): Mabel's time, not his.
So Jonah had the headlamp, and the 7:40 p.m. person the penlight. By clue 6, Jonah came at 8:00 p.m.: he reached the Point.
Clue 1 gives Linus the bike light, so he did not come at 7:40 p.m. He reached the pier at 7:00 p.m.
Priya reached the slipway at 7:40 p.m. with the penlight. Clue 8 gives Mabel the lantern, and Zeke has the flashlight.
solution.epilogue: Jonah took Felix's dinghy from its slip and rowed out to Thimble Point by headlamp, landing at 8:00 p.m. The other four stayed on the shore, on foot, with their own lights.

answer_line: Jonah rowed out to Thimble Point after dark.
